data.content: For nearly a decade we have closely cooperated with Vetëvendosje (Self-Determination), supporting their activities and election campaigns, producing some of the most memorable messages and playing a significant role in the continuous growth and success of this political party.
General elections of 2017 marked a historical moment for Vetëvendosje, doubling in size, unlike any other party ever in the history of our country.

The Heart, a symbol of Victory, Vetëvendosje and love for the country, designed and developed by our team, became the single most memorable election message to date, playing a crucial role in the huge success during the 2017 campaigns, both in national and local elections.
Our responsibility was to design and produce various election materials for the local campaigns in 2013 and 2017, focusing in the second round campaign for the Mayor of Prishtina, detailed below.
The real challenge during this race for the capital city was the second round, and the unbelievable victory from being behind 9000 votes in the first round.
To help achieve this, we created a brand. The Bird became the symbol that followed Shpend Ahmeti to his historical victory, breaking the deadlock created by the ruling power for decades.
Having won the previous elections, the challenge we faced was a whole different ball game. Maintaining the pole position, they say, is more difficult than gaining it.
However, with now a seasoned Mayor, and a more experienced team behind him, the race for the capital city was won once again. We admit, it was a rough ride, but we enjoyed every minute of it.
During our cooperation, we produced a vast amount of printed and digital material for mini-campaigns, events, activities and numerous protests throughout the years.
